business.description: Orchasp Limited is an IT services and digital transformation company offering platforms in health tech (indusayush, induskare), logistics (induscargo), retail (indusretail), human capital management (indusnetworx), and handcrafted products (induscrafts), along with IT offerings such as E-Billing, Asset Management, Vendor Management, Payroll, HRMS, Document Management, and Workflow Automation.

outlook.statement: Planning to launch platforms that align with smart digital access services to customers in health tech, retail, cargo, human capital management, and crafts, creating a connected digital ecosystem supporting healthcare innovation, retail excellence, logistics efficiency, artisan empowerment, and workforce management in B2B and B2C space.
Focused on embracing emerging technologies, driving innovation, and delivering exceptional services to enable clients to thrive in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

The global economy is expected to maintain a steady growth trajectory over the next three (3) to five (5) years despite persistent geopolitical uncertainties, inflationary pressures, and evolving global trade dynamics. Technology-led productivity improvements, digital transformation, artificial intelligence (AI), and infrastructure investments are expected to remain key drivers of long-term economic growth.

Worldwide IT spending is projected to reach approximately US$6.37 trillion in 2026, reflecting continued enterprise investments in AI infrastructure, enterprise software, cloud platforms, and IT services.

India's technology industry is expected to exceed USD 315 billion in revenue during FY2025–26, reflecting continued demand for digital engineering, cloud computing, AI-led transformation, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, and managed services.

India's enterprise IT spending is forecast to exceed USD 176 billion in 2026, driven by increased investments in cloud technologies, AI infrastructure, cybersecurity, data analytics, hyper automation, application modernization, and customer experience transformation.

The long-term outlook for the technology sector remains encouraging. India's digital economy continues to expand; enterprises are accelerating technology investments and digital transformation remains a strategic priority across industries.
